facts.fact: Permanent Secretary Cordu L. Jabang of the Ministry of Information said The Gambia had recently launched an AI-powered fact-checking and verification system, housed under the Ministry, that takes citizens' audio, video, text and voice messages, including in local languages, through a WhatsApp line and returns feedback on whether they are true.
